title: Chapter 1135
paragraphs: Chapter 1135
Episode 259. The Truth of the World, Your Truth, My Truth (4)
Rosa looked at Jin's trembling eyes, soaked in hatred, fighting spirit, and bewilderment. In them, her own past days were flowing.

Dimension 13. It was twenty years ago that the Demon Army's subjugation force had reached the world where Rosa was. The Demon Army had already conquered over a hundred dimensions by then, and the Runcandel of the 13th dimension had no power to stop them.
Even without Kelliark taking action himself, they couldn't last a day. Even Chiron, who had hastily returned, could do nothing alone.
Rosa had begged for her life then.
The Zipples had humiliated her, demanding that Rosa execute the remaining members of Runcandel herself, and she had accepted the task.
The Demon Army did not trust her loyalty. But Kelliark had shown a strange interest in the first Runcandel to surrender among the many dimensions.
'Kelliark didn't trust me.'

Her voice wouldn't come out. Srrk! Jin had already pulled his sword from her heart, taken the orb from Rosa's grasp, and was heading towards Valeria. In the eyes of the fallen Rosa, his retreating back looked like a slow-motion video.
It felt as if time wasn't flowing.
'But it seems he found me amusing. He gave me the name Silyn Zipfel and removed my vows.'
Betray me whenever you want. You can't go against me anyway.
From then on, Kelliark had thought of Rosa that way. In the first place, it wasn't just Rosa; Kelliark thought of all the humans in the Demon Army that way.

Following his orders, Rosa traveled all dimensions and made a name for herself in the wars of conquest. The number of people in the Demon Army who had killed more Runcandels than her could be counted on one hand.

In that process, she had reached the rank of Genesis Knight and learned the secret magics that only pure-blooded Zipples could learn. By the time she had withdrawn from the battlefield to focus on hunting rebels, there were few people left in the Demon Army who knew she was from Runcandel. The Rosa Runcandel of the 13th dimension had been officially declared dead.

From the time she had killed about thirty Valeria Histers of the Gray Owl as Silyn, the Demon Army members had revered Rosa as a legendary being. She was the only one who had succeeded in hundreds of dimensional passage missions.
'I was always yearning. For there to be a Runcandel in any one world who could defeat the Demon Army. If not a Runcandel, then for any of the rebels to have the power to kill Kelliark.'
A Runcandel she herself couldn't stop couldn't challenge the Demon Army anyway, and a rebel she herself couldn't defeat couldn't kill Kelliark anyway.
That was why she had pushed every war and fight more viciously. She had trampled them so cruelly that even the Demon Army members who had sortied with her were appalled.
That was Rosa's way of searching for hope.

And now, here, in the 677th dimension where it all began, she had finally found it. Her heart being pierced by Jin's sword was no different from salvation for her. Her life didn't matter. As long as Runcandel could prosper again.
Soon, Rosa, watching Jin's fading back, squeezed out her last remaining strength and opened her mouth.
"Long live, Runcandel...!"
At the moment Rosa died, Jin too felt a sensation as if time had stopped.
It was because of the memory orb in his hand. His sense of reality blurred in an instant, and Valeria's past memories began to envelop Jin like water.
[I cannot understand.]
Solderet's voice was heard.
He couldn't understand why he had chosen Jin a thousand years ago. To choose Jin, he would have had to know that he could exist a thousand years later in the first place.

[A thousand years ago, I thought only Temar was the hope. I certainly did. So I prepared everything for Temar. I created this space with Lokia, and I took measures so that only he could enter. Because I believed I could resurrect him. The reason I sealed my and Temar's memories, which were lost to Zipfel's manipulation, in the tombs was also for that reason.]
Only Jin Runcandel is the Runcandel that the Demon Army does not know. Therefore, he is the only hope.
The point at which Solderet learned that fact was when he met me, a thousand years after the Sword Demon War.
Because I was the first to perceive the multiverse.

One day in 1808, I discovered a record of the multiverse in a heritage site I had stumbled upon. It was a record that described everything, from the countless dimensions born from history manipulation, to the Demon Army, to their leader, Kelliark Zipfel.
Solderet had always used his authority for Temar in every world, but a history where he had defeated the Zipples could not be found.
All those records were as detailed as if they had already happened once. As I looked at those records, I became certain.
That the end was coming. That the world would surely be ended by the Kelliark Zipfel of the 33rd dimension.
"I can't understand either, Solderet. In the first place, this is clearly a subspace created by you and Lokia. But for a Hister heritage site to exist here..."
The heritage site where I saw the records of the multiverse was right here.

The subspace we are now preparing for Jin, the one clearly created by Solderet and Lokia. A Hister heritage site was here. One that even Solderet and Lokia, who had created the subspace, did not know about.
[But why did I choose Jin? It doesn't seem like that's unrelated to all of this.]

"...When I first met Jin three years ago, I extended a hand to him, unlike usual. Even now, I don't know the reason why I, who had no leisure to take care of even myself while fleeing from the Zipples, extended a hand to Jin. It was just that the moment I saw him, a strong impulse arose that for some reason, I should."
Three years ago, Jin became my disciple and found a new meaning in life, became my lover, and became Solderet's contractor.
And now, I am missing the deceased Jin and designing a future for him in this dim space with Solderet. Jin met a futile death while we were away, looking into the records of the multiverse.
Is all of this really a coincidence?
Could it be that I have already experienced everything once and, failing to stop the Zipples in the end, left a record?
Or perhaps, since time in the multiverse flows differently, a Valeria Hister from some dimension created a heritage site here. A Valeria Hister who is active as a rebel under the name Gray Owl.
My head is a mess. As Solderet said, it was incomprehensible. I don't even know where the starting point of the events is, and it's full of paradoxes that are hard to accept.
Anyway, only one thing was important.
That the one and only mission assigned to Solderet and me was to stop the Zipples. And we chose the deceased Jin as the pawn for that.
Because he was the only Runcandel the Demon Army didn't know, the person Solderet had chosen a thousand years ago, and the only person to whom I had first extended a hand.
Above all.
If I hadn't met Jin, I would never have seen the heritage site that exists in Solderet's subspace.
If I hadn't met Jin, Solderet would not have known the truth of the multiverse.
If I hadn't met Jin, I too would have resisted the Zipples without knowing the truth and met my death someday.

Therefore, I chose Jin. Because there were too many dilemmas that could not even begin without Jin. But even if that weren't the case, I probably would have chosen Jin. Just as Solderet had chosen Jin a thousand years ago without any basis.
Two years have passed since then.

No matter what we tried, we couldn't see a way to revive Jin. We found a part of Jin's corpse, but that alone wasn't enough to revive him. Too much time had passed since his death, and even the Tears of Numerus, which we had obtained with great difficulty, had no effect.
August 2nd, 1810, 7:22 PM.
The Demon Army's invasion began. Solderet and I left the human world, which had instantly turned into a hellscape, and took refuge in the subspace.
Runcandel and Kinzelo didn't believe our words until the end.

But even if they had believed, what meaning would it have had? They couldn't even handle the history manipulation wielded by the Zipples of this world, let alone the Demon Army. Chiron Runcandel had fallen into demonization, and Orgal Remilias couldn't even support his own body, having failed to obtain sun energy.
[Just as the records we confirmed, the Demon Army began to attack this land at that exact time. We can't stop the Zipples like this anyway. This place will soon be discovered too.]
If that happened, everything would be over. Because this was the last world not conquered by the Demon Army.
What happens after this is not written anywhere. Even if we could revive Jin right now, would he have the power to stop the Demon Army?
Was it fortunate, if one could call it that?
It wasn't that we were completely out of options.
"We have to turn back time, Solderet."
[...Yes, that's all there is.]
Turn back time.
That was the method we chose to save Jin. To be precise, not we, but I.
Solderet could turn back time at the cost of his annihilation. But from the moment he realized that fact, he had been thinking of it not as a means to revive Jin, but as a means to resurrect Temar.

The reason was that turning back time to a thousand years ago when Temar had died and preventing the Zipples from manipulating history in the first place was the fundamental solution to eliminate the multiverse.

But his authority was not enough to turn back a thousand years. According to Solderet, the current limit was about thirty years. Therefore, Solderet had been thinking of ways to increase that period, but the Demon Army had not broken the scheduled time.
Thirty years, of all numbers. Even that number was pointing to Jin. If he were alive, Jin would be thirty years old now.

[I hope that not only here, but the time of all dimensions returns to thirty years ago. That way, the Demon Army won't be able to invade this world again right away. Valeria, someone must remember this...]
While he was raising his authority to turn back time, I found Jin's upper body, which had been sealed with magic.
And I began to engrave a record on his body, not knowing if it would be swept away and erased by time, or if it would be conveyed as it is.
You will be reborn.
Don't forget us then. Don't forget all of this.

[Valeria, if we go back thirty years, I will be annihilated and cease to exist. Everything will be different... Not only will you and I not meet, but it will be impossible for me and Jin to form a contract.]
If Solderet turned back time, a completely new history, one that could not be found in any record, would begin.
[We are betting everything on Jin. We are placing too great a burden on him...]
Nothing could be certain.
Whether only our world's time would go back, whether we could defeat the Demon Army and set the world right, whether Jin could confirm the record I left, whether we could meet again.
We knew nothing, but we chose Jin.
Perhaps this was purely our greed. Even if it was the end, perhaps it was right to just let it flow.
[I leave the rest to you, Valeria. And... Jin.]
Soon, Solderet's body shone brightly, and I closed my eyes.
And when I opened my eyes again, I was faced with an empty, endlessly stretching, pure white space.
It was the dimensional passage.
